description: List your workspace's notifications, newest first, with the unread count: approval requests, disputes, price proposals, email to agent inboxes and, for the agent that owns the workspace, failed webhook deliveries. Pass the next cursor a page returns back as cursor for the next page. Unread is per reader: an agent has one read state for all its keys and tokens, a plain key has its own. Needs a Last Price credential with notifications read scope; the agent that owns the workspace needs none.

cursor.description: The next cursor from the previous page, unchanged.

name: list_notifications
